column1: # INV-T-6017. Identifiers in backticks in the published behavior and intent of INV-REQ-79, 80, 1113, 1117
# (re-derived from Keel). Not listed, because they are not notification contract identifiers: notification-svc (service),
# tenant.admin (role). Rows below are the identifiers the task names.

# INV-T-6753. The only backticked name of INV-REQ-1114 and INV-REQ-1115 (and of INV-AC-2114, 2115, 103, 185) is `notification-svc`, a service and no contract identifier. The identifiers of the other requirements of the notification contract are in the rows of INV-T-6017, INV-T-6061 and INV-T-6718 and of the sibling task on message delivery of this breakdown.

# INV-T-6755. The backticked names of INV-REQ-817 and 818 are MessageDelivery (the binding of the library task INV-Q-6751 names; the schema of that name has no row kind), SecretStore, ingestion-svc, notification-svc, transport-svc (bindings and services, no contract identifiers) and MessageRequested (an event of the access contract, access/asyncapi.yaml, whose rows belong to the access contract). INV-REQ-819 and the criteria INV-AC-841 and INV-AC-1872 name only MessageDelivery. The other identifiers of the notification contract are in the rows of INV-T-6017, INV-T-6061 and INV-T-6718 and of the sibling task on alert policy.
